goal: Make reserved Review dispatch resilient to provider and artifact failures: dispatch preconditions are verified before spawning, immutable review bundle artifacts outlive unsettled reservations, and provider failures that produce no verdict never consume review rounds or block re-dispatch of the reserved operation.

acceptance.assertion: Immutable review bundle artifacts, including evidence.json, persist under the reservation lock until the bound reservation reaches terminal settlement or explicit release; garbage collection never removes artifacts referenced by an unsettled reservation; dispatch or settlement that finds a required artifact missing fails closed, writes zero authority, and exposes an explicit re-reserve path; bundle capture, lock, and cleanup ordering is enumerated by trigger (settle, release, crash, shutdown) crossed with state (reserved, dispatched, settling, terminal) with a single artifact owner per state.

Provider quota and transport failures during standard Agent dispatch are classified as no-verdict dispatch failures: they write zero authority, leave the reserved operation valid, emit no terminal review event, consume no review follow-up round, and permit exactly one re-dispatch of the same reserved operation; validated native terminal status remains the only verdict source.
The complete Pi extension graph passes strict TypeScript checking and the full repository test suite passes with no regressions.
